tools.name: workflows_list
tools.description: Lists the community's automations/workflows, newest first, paginated. Each record is a lean summary (id, name, status, type); it omits the trigger/actions graph and any URL - fetch a single workflow to get the full graph. Filters are optional and combine with AND. `status` semantics (note the omit-vs-all difference): - omit -> all workflows, INCLUDING archived - `all` -> all workflows EXCEPT archived - `archived` -> only archived workflows - `draft` / `active` / `inactive` -> only workflows with that status. Optional: query, status, workflow_type (plus 2 more). Returns the WorkflowsList.

params.description: Filter by workflow name (substring match).

params.name: status
params.description: Filter by status. Omit to include archived; use `all` to exclude archived; use `archived` for only archived.

params.name: workflow_type

params.description: Page number (min 1)

params.description: Records per page (max 100)
